decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The crossover shall be constructed in accordance with approved plan and shall not exceed 2.4 meters in width

Condition : 5 - Before the vehicle access hereby permitted is used full details of landscaping works for the proposed front flower bed shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and these works shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 6 - Before the vehicle access hereby permitted is used a front boundary wall shall be reinstated, except at the point of access to the path and hard standing, as shown on the submitted drawing. The wall shall be no greater than 600 mm in height and shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 7 - Prior to the construction of the vehicular access the lamp column currently located in front of the property shall be relocated to avoid conflict with vehicles entering and leaving the site.
